What is Ship It Design intent

What is Ship It

A resume can list the launches. It cannot show the calls. Launch marketing is decided weeks before the data arrives, on a calendar that does not move, with a team that cannot do everything. I built Ship It so you can watch that judgment happen instead of taking my word for it. Eight beats, four meters, about three minutes. If you are hiring for a launch role, this is the interview answer, playable.

Design intent

The game is built on the tensions that decide real launches. Hype against sentiment: announce loud and early, or protect the community trust you will need at launch. Budget against team energy: the Summer Game Fest premiere and the creator summit both work, and you cannot afford either one twice. Every meter is something a marketing lead is actually judged on, and there is no version where all four stay green.
